symbols.name: padded bit volume
symbols.meaning: The bit volume Tp of the padded arrays, which counts their stored bits up to a constant factor.
symbols.quote: Each cost is divided by $V=Tp$, the bit volume of the padded arrays, where $T\approx n/b$ is the transform size, so $V=\Theta(n)$.

symbols.name: stage margin
symbols.meaning: The margin below one of the i-th stage's power, a number below one, so that the power is p^(1-g_i).
symbols.quote: Write $g_i$ for the margin below one of the $i$th stage's power, so that the power is $p^{1-g_i}$:

symbols.name: power-saving constant
symbols.meaning: The fixed constant 2^(-182), half the smallest stage margin.
symbols.quote: The constant $\kappa=2^{-182}$ is therefore half the smallest margin, the largest value the argument allows.

relations.quote: Summing the stage costs bounds the cost of [The multiplication algorithm](multiplication-algorithm.md) on $n$-bit inputs.

The stage sizes are set by [Parameter choices for the padded box](parameter-choice.md): $p=6b$ with $b=\lceil\log_2 n\rceil$, so $p=\Theta(\log n)$, $d=\Theta(p^\epsilon)$ axes, and chunk width $K=\Theta(p^{\epsilon c})$.
The chunk-exchange row follows from [Fast address-chunk interchange](address-chunk-interchange.md), which gives $O(VK^\tau)$ for each exchange of width-$K$ chunks.
The simultaneous butterfly rounds are based on [Simultaneous normalized butterfly layer](simultaneous-butterfly-layer.md), each costing $O(Vd^{\lambda'})$.
The Gaussian row is built from the line passes of [Tensor resampling on a padded box](tensor-resampling.md) along the $d$ axes.
The bound accounts for the stages of [Convolution from the retained transform layout](synthetic-convolution.md): two forward transforms, pointwise products and the opposite transform.
